champion.tips: CAMILLE TIPS AND TRICKS In team fights, try to flank the enemy. Use your Ultimate on a carry or someone you can take out straight away. Before initiating with your E, check the minimap. Do not go in unless you know it is clear; otherwise, you will overextended and die! Can’t get kills in the bottom lane? Look to roam around the map and make plays elsewhere. Teaming up with your Jungler is a good idea too.
champion.builds: THE BEST CAMILLE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Camille Support build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Hail of Blades as your keystone, followed by Sudden Impact, Deep Ward and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Shield Bash and Bone Plating in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Bloodsong as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Eclipse. For your last 3 items, you should build Sundered Sky, Sterak's Gage and finish with Guardian Angel. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 48.5% winrate over 1 776 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Hail of Blades as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Deep Ward and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, and Shield Bash with Bone Plating in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Celestial Opposition as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Trinity Force as a third item. You want to finish the build with Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance and Guardian Angel. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 45.7% win rate across 94 matches played. Situational Camille Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Camille build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Camille runes page.
